* hex-repack: proper filtering for BF16 that were leaking through during the tests

* hex-repack: streamling tiling rules (broken MM for now)

* hex-repack: rename repacked to tiled in all flags/funcs/kernels/vars

* hex-mm: fix valid_rows calc in various kernels

* hex-mm: remove unused hvx_mm_nx_2d_flat

* hex-mm: cleanup and optimize hvx-tiled vec_dot_f16

* hex-mm: another pass at hvx-tiled f16 matmul

* hex-get-rows: optimize small src1

* hex-get-rows: one more pass at recovering get-rows perf regression

* hex-repack: export GGML_HEXAGON_RT_REPACK via run.py

* hex-mm-tiled: fix accuracy regression with hmx-tiled-f16 matmul

* hex-mm: fold tiled_f16 checks into the general flow

* hex-get-rows: remove dead checks for buffer_is_hexagon and tiling during supports_op

* hex-quant: proper tail handling in new dequant ukernels

* hex-get-rows: remove unused code and cleanup support checks

* hex-mm: cleanup ne1 padding/tiling checks

* hex-mm: cleanup fusion checks for tiled tensors

* hex-repack: add a little can_repack helper to reduce duplication

* hex-repack: never repack host buffers

* hex-repack: factor out repack functions into separate .h and .cpp

* hex-tensor: cleanup tensor ifaces for tiled/padded sizes

* hex-repack: update k-quant tiling comments and cleanup #defines

* hex-dcache: factor out l2/dcache dirty tracking and flushing

* hex-tensor: update docs and remove #defs duplication

* hex-tensor: remove unused/incorrect get_data interface

* hex-get-rows: cleanup vtcm layout build

* tests: disable huge MM tests

* hex-dcache: add missing header

body:
## Overview

llama.cpp v0.7.0 adds the LiliCorr speculative decoding technique and MTP for GLM5-Next, a new GPU cache for MoE experts kept in host memory (`--moe-cache-mib`, up to ~2.2x decode speedup when experts are offloaded), and a large batch of new models: K2 Horizon (dense and MoVA), Prism Bonsai 2 27B, EmbeddingGemma-2 (text+vision+audio), the LiquidAI d1/d1-omni and vLLM decision 2/d3 decision models, pplx-decider, MiniCPM-V 4.7, Nemotron Super 3.5 VL / Nemotron Bolt and maion-coder. The server gets a refactored chat session API (`common_chat_session`, part-based formatted output), much better slot and prompt-cache restore behavior, decision-model support for the new architectures and a new default port (9931), the web UI gains a full models manager, and ggml is updated to v0.27.0.

### Highlights

- New GPU cache for host-memory MoE experts (`--moe-cache-mib`): experts run on the GPU from an LRU cache, up to 2.2x faster decode [#29887](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29887)
- The expert cache is now shared across multiple GPUs [#30112](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30112)
- LiliCorr speculative decoding: candidate selection with a small draft transformer on top of DFlash [#30506](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30506)
- GLM5-Next: MTP speculative decoding with an optimized sparse attention path [#29928](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29928)
- K2 Horizon support in both dense and MoVA variants: conversion, tokenizer, chat template, `-sm tensor` splitting [#29535](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29535)
- Prism Bonsai 2 27B ternary model support [#29600](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29600)
- EmbeddingGemma-2: text + vision + audio embedding model [#30054](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30054)
- New decision models: LiquidAI d1-3B, d1-omni-600M, vLLM decision 2, vLLM d3 and pplx-decider [#30110](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30110) [#30114](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30114) [#30378](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30378) [#30383](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30383) [#30044](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30044)
- PLaMo-3 tokenizer implements reference pre-segmentation for exact tokenization parity [#30045](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30045)
- RPC server supports `-sm tensor` (tensor-parallel RPC, RPC protocol v8) [#26610](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26610)
- Server now listens on port 9931 by default instead of 8080 [#30159](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30159)

### Core changes

- Speculative decoding: MTP for GLM5-Next, LiliCorr drafts, correct mtmd handling in MTP graphs [#29928](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29928) [#30506](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30506) [#30257](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30257)
- Speculative decoding: shared nextn tensor flags with consolidated row cropping and sched re-reserve on flag change [#30097](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30097) [#30017](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30017) [#30020](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30020)
- Speculative decoding: fixed draft sampling and rejection handling, DFlash output head sharing [#30095](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30095) [#30111](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30111)
- New `--spec-draft-n-ubatch` to size the draft context batch separately and save VRAM [#30459](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30459)
- MoE expert cache: host-memory experts served from a device LRU cache, supported over multiple GPUs [#29887](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29887) [#30112](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30112)
- Embedding models: skip the logits buffer and the LM head when pooling is enabled (up to 10x less VRAM) [#30255](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30255) [#30445](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30445)
- Embedding graphs: reordered `get_rows`, dropped the redundant `t_embd` expand and leftover `ggml_cont` calls [#30160](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30160) [#30461](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30461) [#30198](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30198)
- No-cache attention: padded KV dimension and KQ bias, avoided graph reallocations [#30416](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30416) [#30446](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30446) [#30439](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30439)
- k-pool models: selection built in the causal mask layout, fixed a scatter data race on shared sequences [#30480](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30480) [#29994](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29994)
- GLM5-Next sparse attention: removed the gather path [#30042](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30042)
- KV cache: honor `LLAMA_STATE_SEQ_FLAGS_PARTIAL_ONLY` so draft checkpoints stop carrying the full KV [#30514](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30514)
- Prefetching: merge ranges before issuing system prefetch calls, never map foreign ranges into a backend buffer [#30532](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30532) [#30405](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30405)
- Sampling: greedy selection for eligible temperature-zero chains, backend sampling graph kept static across ubatches [#29797](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29797) [#30223](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30223)
- Tokenizers: PLaMo-3 pre-segmentation and FiM tokens, opt-in NFC normalization for Unigram, strict UTF-8 validation [#30045](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30045) [#30090](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30090) [#30390](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30390) [#30485](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30485)
- Jinja: fixed loop variable scoping, Python-compatible `tojson` rendering, faster context copy [#30533](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30533) [#30483](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30483) [#30362](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30362) [#30562](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30562)

### ggml changes

- ggml updated to [v0.27.0](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases/tag/v0.27.0): the backend scheduler gains user callbacks for split weight copying and compute-buffer reallocation, and the RPC protocol is bumped to v8 for tensor-parallel RPC servers. Backends gained chunked gated-delta-net kernels on CUDA/HIP, KleidiAI SME2 k-quant matmuls and AVX2 Q2_0 dot products on CPU, L2-aware coopmat2 scheduling and bf16 activations on Vulkan, reordered-layout MoE kernels (MXFP4, IQ3, Q5_K, grouped XMX GEMM) on SYCL, dp4a MoE GEMMs on OpenCL, tensor-API and wider-head-dim flash attention on Metal, and a DMA/HVX copy overhaul with pooling and 3D im2col ops on Hexagon. Correctness work focused on non-contiguous and strided views, grid and workgroup size limits, out-of-bounds accesses and well-defined `mul_mat_id` behavior for duplicate expert ids; symbol visibility now defaults to hidden
